accessTokens.title: Personal access tokens
accessTokens.description: Tokens let Claude and other MCP clients read and, if you allow it, write in your workspace with your permissions. Treat them like a password.
accessTokens.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop

scope.chatWrite: Post, edit and delete your messages
scope.imRead: List your direct messages and group DMs
scope.imWrite: Send, edit and delete your direct messages
scope.searchRead: Search messages, files, people and channels (DM results need DM history)
scope.filesRead: List files and read text file contents

accessTokens.neverWarning: Tokens without an expiration stay valid until you revoke them.
accessTokens.createdNotice: Copy your new token now. You won't be able to see it again.
accessTokens.empty: You have no personal access tokens.

errors.createFailed: Failed to create the token. Please try again.
errors.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
errors.limitReached: You can have up to {max} active tokens. Revoke one you no longer use and try again.
errors.codeRequired: Enter your two-factor code to create a token.

accessTokens.codeHint: Enter a code from your authenticator app to create a token.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: These devices are signed in to your account. Sign out any you do not recognize or no longer use.
sessions.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices
sessions.signOutOthersConfirm: {count, plural, one {Sign out # other device} other {Sign out # other devices}}
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of all other devices

errors.revokeFailed: Failed to sign out. Please try again.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePassword.sessionsNote: When you change your password, your other signed-in devices are signed out.

errors.failed: Could not change your password. Try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password when you sign in.
twoFactor.recoveryRemaining: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
twoFactor.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available on this server. Ask your administrator.

setup.step1: 1. Add this account to your authenticator app. Open the link on your phone, or enter the setup key by hand.
setup.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code your app shows.
setup.sessionsNote: When you turn this on, your other signed-in devices are signed out.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Use a recovery code to sign in if you lose your device. Each code works once. They will not be shown again.
recovery.fileHeader: Recovery codes. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe.

reauth.codeInvalid: Enter a valid authentication or recovery code.

regenerate.title: Make new recovery codes
regenerate.description: Your old recovery codes stop working as soon as you make new ones. Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
regenerate.lowNotice: {count, plural, one {Only # recovery code is left} other {Only # recovery codes are left}}. Make new ones before you run out.

disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication
disable.description: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
disable.blockedByPolicy: Your organization requires two-factor authentication, so you cannot turn it off. If you lost your device, ask an administrator to reset it.
